title: EVERYDAY WORKS — everyday utility concept collection
status: Design concept, not a launched collection

brand.name_status: Working name only; no trademark clearance or availability check performed
brand.positioning: Friendly, functional gear, wear and home essentials with clear uses, simple construction and accessible target prices.
brand.promise: Easy to understand. Easy to use. Designed to earn its place.
brand.audience: People who want ordinary days to run a little more smoothly, without paying for decorative complexity.
principles: One clear job, with a second useful detail
Plain product names and visible prices
Fewer panels, parts and custom trims
Shared fabrics, webbing and hardware across products
Simple shape, soft corners, tactile surface
Make the affordable version good before adding features

palette.name: Cobalt
palette.role: Main brand, headings, handles and key actions

palette.name: Tomato
palette.role: Small utility details, tabs and accent objects

palette.name: Butter
palette.role: Warm panels, home objects and product hero fields

palette.name: Cream
palette.role: Canvas, page ground and breathing room

visual_system.typography: Heavy, compact, uppercase system sans-serif for wordmark and product names; regular system sans-serif for specifications; large lining numerals for target prices.
visual_system.mark: An original text-only EVERYDAY WORKS wordmark. Optional small open square as a catalog index device. No oval, flag device, imitation logo or implied partnership.
visual_system.layout: Bold catalog hierarchy, generous cream space, clean columns, clear category labels, one useful fact near every object.
visual_system.packaging: One-color paper sleeve or flat hangtag where feasible; name, purpose, dimensions and care after testing. No ornamental outer boxes.
visual_system.photography: Soft daylight or a clean cream studio; honest textile and molded surface texture; attainable small-space settings; product before lifestyle.
visual_system.accessibility: Use charcoal or cobalt text on cream/butter. Reserve tomato for accents, and do not rely on color alone to convey category or interaction.

do: Say when a claim is only a target
avoid: Sustainability or ethical certifications without evidence
Any suggestion of collaboration with another brand

pricing.disclosure: All prices are unquoted design targets in USD, not supplier quotes, live offers or validated retail prices. Taxes and delivery are not modeled.
pricing.assumptions: Simple high-volume construction, narrow color assortment, shared components and direct retail. No supplier, production volume, duty, freight, tooling, testing, margin or returns model has been validated.
pricing.design_goal: Keep most small essentials under $15 and every initial concept under $30.
pricing.launch_sequence: Start with sewn carry goods, the pocket tee and a simple cap; cost and test fitted apparel next; validate tooling and safety before molded home products.

products.name: DAY TOTE
products.tagline: A little room for every day.
products.everyday_use: Groceries, library books and the extra layer you take everywhere.
products.material_construction: Proposed 10–12 oz cotton canvas, stock cotton or polyester webbing, boxed corners, double-fold top hem and reinforced handle attachment points.
products.design_dimensions: About 36 × 34 × 13 cm; approximately 16 L as a design intent, subject to sampling.
products.feasibility_note: $12 is ambitious with heavy canvas and long webbing; sample a lighter fabric and simple unlined pattern before fixing the price. Carry load is untested.

products.name: ZIP POUCH
products.everyday_use: Collect charging cables, pens or loose daily essentials inside a bigger bag.
products.material_construction: Two simple cotton-canvas panels, boxed lower corners and one stock coil zipper; no lining or internal divisions.
products.feasibility_note: A stock zipper and minimal sewing keep the design credible, but $5 needs sufficient order volume; custom zipper pulls would add avoidable cost.

products.name: CROSSBODY
products.tagline: The pockets you can take off.
products.everyday_use: Carry a phone, keys and wallet on a short errand or walk.
products.material_construction: Unlined midweight polyester plain weave or twill, stock coil zipper, stock webbing and acetal strap adjuster.
products.design_dimensions: About 20 × 16 × 6 cm; fit to be validated with representative phones.
products.feasibility_note: The target excludes padded dividers, metal trim and waterproof construction; extra internal organization could quickly push cost above it.

products.name: BOTTLE LOOP
products.tagline: A free hand for the rest.
products.everyday_use: Add a short carrying loop to a compatible bottle with an existing handle or attachment point.
products.material_construction: Short stock polyester webbing loop with a small stock acetal side-release buckle and two reinforced seams.
products.design_dimensions: About 20 cm finished loop; compatibility depends on the bottle handle.
products.feasibility_note: Compatibility and loaded-buckle testing are essential; this is an accessory only, and the bottle shown in the catalog is a styling prop.

products.name: POCKET TEE
products.tagline: One good tee. One useful pocket.
products.everyday_use: An easy everyday base layer with a small chest pocket for light essentials.
products.material_construction: Proposed 180–200 gsm cotton jersey with stock rib, conventional cut-and-sew construction and one patch pocket.
products.design_dimensions: Adult size range to be developed and fit-tested; no final size chart yet.
products.feasibility_note: $10 requires disciplined fabric, color and size inventory; shrinkage, twist and colorfastness need wash testing before making care or fit claims.

products.name: EASY PANTS
products.tagline: Room to move, pockets to use.
products.everyday_use: Comfortable trousers for the commute, desk, errands and home.
products.material_construction: Proposed lightweight cotton/polyester twill, elastic waistband, stock drawcord and simple pocket bags; no zip fly.
products.design_dimensions: Adult sizing and inseam options to be determined through fit development.
products.feasibility_note: Fit development and size coverage are the main cost risks; the target assumes one core block and limited inseam options, which must be assessed for accessibility.

products.name: UTILITY OVERSHIRT
products.tagline: An extra layer, ready by the door.
products.everyday_use: A light outer layer for cool mornings, indoor work and casual everyday use.
products.material_construction: Proposed 220–260 gsm cotton/polyester twill, unlined body, stock buttons and straightforward collar and cuff construction.
products.design_dimensions: Adult sizing to be developed; intended as a relaxed overshirt, not protective workwear.
products.feasibility_note: $29 is a demanding target once fit, buttons and sewing labor are included; fewer seam details and shared fabric are important. No protective-workwear claim is implied.

products.name: 6-PANEL CAP
products.tagline: Grab it on the way out.
products.everyday_use: A simple everyday cap with an adjustable fit.
products.material_construction: Standard six-panel cotton twill pattern, stock buckle or hook-and-loop closure and reinforced brim insert.
products.design_dimensions: Adjustable adult fit range to be validated on samples.
products.feasibility_note: Use an existing cap pattern and stock trims to protect the target; custom head shapes and embroidery add sampling cost. No UPF rating is claimed.

products.name: STACK STOOL
products.tagline: One more seat. A little less space.
products.everyday_use: A compact extra seat that nests away when floor space matters.
products.material_construction: Proposed single-piece ribbed injection-molded polypropylene body, with geometry and feet developed through engineering.
products.design_dimensions: About 34 × 34 × 43 cm, subject to structural design and stability testing.
products.feasibility_note: Mold tooling and safety testing are major up-front costs; the target only makes sense at volume. No load rating exists, and it is not a step stool.

products.name: ENTRY TRAY
products.everyday_use: Give keys, coins and everyday pocket contents one visible place near the door.
products.material_construction: Simple injection-molded polypropylene tray with draft-friendly sides and a lightly textured base.
products.feasibility_note: Low part complexity helps, but a new mold must still be amortized; this is an entry organizer, with no food-contact suitability claim.

products.name: WALL POCKET
products.tagline: Use the space you already have.
products.everyday_use: Organize mail, notebooks and light accessories on a hook near the door or desk.
products.material_construction: Canvas backing with three simple patch pockets, webbing hanging loops and a removable slim stock dowel for shape.
products.design_dimensions: About 25 × 72 cm; mounting hardware not specified.
products.feasibility_note: Pocket seams, dowel and hanging method need load testing; mounting requirements vary by wall, so universal fixings cannot be assumed.

products.name: FOLDING CRATE
products.everyday_use: Group pantry overflow, cleaning supplies or small household objects and fold it away when empty.
products.material_construction: Proposed polypropylene panels with stock-style snap hinges and a ribbed base; hinge geometry to be engineered.
products.design_dimensions: About 40 × 30 × 22 cm open; final folded thickness unknown.
products.feasibility_note: Multiple molds, hinges and assembly make $12 uncertain without high volume; repeated fold-cycle and stacking tests are required. No loaded stacking claim yet.

hero.headline:
Useful things.
Every day.
hero.body: A colorful system of practical essentials, designed around everyday jobs and accessible target prices.

price_explainer.headline: Good design starts with a clear target.
price_explainer.body: The collection starts at a $3 concept target. Simple shapes, shared materials and fewer parts help keep the ambition grounded. Every price still needs supplier costing and testing.

detail_story.headline: A loop. A pocket. A place for it.
detail_story.body: Small, understandable details make ordinary things more useful. Nothing needs a manual to make sense.

closing.headline: Made for the daily.
closing.body: An original design direction for gear, wear and home. Ready for prototypes, costing and real-world use tests.

content_blocks.footer_disclosure: Design concepts only. All prices are unquoted target retail in USD. Dimensions, materials, colors, performance and manufacturability remain subject to development. No current availability, certified sustainability, tested safety rating or affiliation with another brand is claimed.

qa.claim_check: Target pricing is explicit. No invented availability, certification or affiliation.
qa.consistency_note: Images are concept illustrations and vary slightly in stool shape and tote pattern. Use the written specifications as design intent and resolve variants through prototyping.
qa.brand_reference_note: The direction uses broad democratic catalog principles with its own palette, wordmark and naming; it does not reproduce another brand's logo or suggest collaboration.
